messages.subject: Re: rJava
parts:
Assuming you want to use Deducer together with JGR, you can also load Deducer via JGR.
library(JGR)
JGR()
Then in JGR Preferences tick Deducer start up options so that JGR will automatically call Deducer at start up each time.

Rudolf
